findings.gittins_discretization: 10-bucket boundary enumeration (frozen spec) makes G == mean on dense conditional distributions (e.g. state (0,'') n=480: G=mean=53280.9); the exact inf is lower (state (5,'planner'): exact 14351.5 = 0.6x mean vs 23930 = mean at boundaries), so gittins_vs_mean_flip is ~0 on this workload. Implementation kept as frozen; sensitivity (exact inf / more buckets) flagged for review.
findings.profile_dependent_mechanisms: Hermes online prewarm and Torpor covered-load ranking need the workload workload_shape / GPU-identity contract (absent in current templates/episodes) and fail closed; their activation evidence is the per-mechanism fidelity tests.
findings.nested_gpu_no_capacity: 5-8 of 30 episodes carry nested-GPU capacity failures for EVERY arm (fcfs 6/30, myopic 5/30) -> pre-existing workload behaviour without extension configs, not a baseline effect.
findings.loader_fail_closed_fix: v041's prefixed causal topology_contract previously escaped the exact-match fail-closed check and loaded as an edgeless legacy graph; fixed to marker-containment plus regression test.
